senses.definition: Running for many steps before anyone can tell whether it worked.
distractors: Safe to run more than once, since the second run leaves things exactly as the first did.
Understood by only a small group, because it assumes background that most people lack.
Built for one customer rather than taken off the shelf.
Lasting only briefly, and meant to.
So small or so easy that it is not worth the time it would take to discuss.
